final_message: The guard-consumption mechanism is complete: the checker reports only when an unconditional parameter-rooted racy read feeds a local that is consumed by flag probes under a parameter mode guard, which fires on the pre-patch __flush_work shape and is correctly suppressed in the fixed revision where the read is a guarded-decl consumed inside the guard itself, so only implementation gates remain.
